title: Fanin bound for XOR reduction
statement: Let $n,k$ be nonnegative integers and let $ps$ be a list of pairs of Boolean circuit trees on $n$ variables, with $|ps|\le k$. Define the pair fanin of $ps$ as the maximum fanin among all circuits in its pairs, taking it to be $0$ for the empty list. The maximum fanin of the two circuits returned by the fuel-bounded XOR reduction is at most the larger of $2$ and the pair fanin of $ps$.
hypotheses_covered: $ps$ is a list of pairs of circuit trees on $n$ variables
